title: Me Me Meka Laga – Dhanya, Nithya & Prasastha Telugu Christian Lyrics
english: Yesu roopu lone – Yesu bidda laaga
Yesu roopu lone – Yesu bidda laaga
translation: You were not made like a bleating goat,
Nor like a barking dog,
Nor like a meowing cat,
You were not created like them.
You are made in the image of Jesus – like a child of Jesus,
You are formed in the hands of Jesus,
You are very, very special,
Let go of all your worries right now,
This is all Jesus’ love—this is the victory,
That is enough—walk with the Lord.
You were not made like a crowing rooster,
Nor like a cawing crow,
Nor like a quacking duck,
You were not created like them.
You are made in the image of Jesus – like a child of Jesus,
You are formed in the hands of Jesus,
You are very, very special,
Let go of all your worries right now,
This is all Jesus’ love—this is the victory,
That is enough—walk with the Lord.
intro: Me Me Meka Laga is the latest Telugu Christian Children song written & tuned by VBS Ministries Bangalore, sung by Dhanya, Nithya, Prasastha and music composed by Bro KJW Prem. This song was released on April 08, 2026, through Dhanya Nithya & Prasastha YouTube Channel.
